proposal.root_cause: Model misinterprets 'Rank' as ordering/counting instead of generating explicit rank numbers (RANK() OVER), and fails to include all requested identifier columns in multi-part questions.
proposal.what: Update system_prompt.md to explicitly instruct the model to use RANK()/DENSE_RANK() window functions when 'rank' is mentioned in the question, rather than just ORDER BY. Also reinforce that if a question asks for a name or reference, it should include forename/surname if available in schema or expected by typical gold patterns for 'reference name' type questions.
